ownerAuditFindingsAddressed.A_segmentDiffEmptyOnError: scopeSegmentDiff() returns an explicit { ok:true, records } or { ok:false, errorCode ('DIFF_FAILED'|'MALFORMED_DIFF'), detail }. A git-diff command failure or a malformed NUL name-status stream blocks; a genuinely empty successful diff stays distinguishable; a mutation edge that yields an empty diff is rejected. Errors propagate into mutationChain per-segment violations and the boundary result. No credentials/raw env in diagnostics.
ownerAuditFindingsAddressed.B_accessorErrorConflatedWithAbsence: Typed accessors commitParents(sha) -> { ok:true, parents } | { ok:false, error } and treeOid(sha) -> { ok:true, present:true, oid } | { ok:true, present:false } | { ok:false, error }. A command failure (ACCESS_ERROR) can no longer masquerade as a true root commit (empty parents), an absent task root (present:false), or a non-merge. Any accessor error fails the chain closed. Root-changing-merge rejection and unchanged-task-merge behavior remain intact; no HEAD^ shortcut or environment transition SHA.
ownerAuditFindingsAddressed.C_historicalHeadsNotFullyValidated: Every mutation-segment head is validated with the canonical validateTask against the exact historical Git tree materialized in a detached temporary worktree (OS temp path, no-EOL conversion, cleanup in finally). Includes TASK_STATE parse/shape/history, IDENTITY + GITHUB_PLAN shape/cross-binding, authorization floor, declared-state/evidence consistency, state-required package presence and full inventory/JSON/manifest/ID/reference validity, stage-dir and unsafe-entry checks. Plus an immutable identity projection (schemaVersion, factoryVersion, taskId, project, countryCode, exchangeId, batchId, priority, createdAt, branch, requiredResearchInventory) frozen from the introduction head that every later head must match, and the same-state repair rule (a package-requiring state must have a complete valid package at that exact commit).
